1.why: Assigned to the market/tolls/corn-rent thread, where 'charge' as a fee asked for service is the thematically live sense; nothing in the option set itself marks one.

2.why: Only option naming a human MOTIVE (a boast) rather than a record-keeping function, and the club's records are the crew's data source in item 4 - the classic 'kept for vanity, useful to science' shape.

3.why: Main-idea item for the library thread; sibling item 5's distinctive 'match entries to where readers live' is an address test, which only discriminates the shut-branch/rival-closing hypothesis.

4.why: Three siblings in this thread (2, 14, and the hatch language) are about an angling club, so the club's records are the established source.

5.why: Each option maps to one candidate cause in items 3/7/8; 'where readers live' is the only geographic test and is the concrete evidential move the thread turns on.

6.why: All five gloss 'set'; in a printing-shop thread the domain sense is setting type = arranged.

7.why: Same five causes as 3 and 8; bet the shut-branch cause for thread consistency, accepting that one of 7/8 may be the reject-item.

8.why: Same five causes as 3 and 7; 'absorbing the readers of a shut branch' is the thread's established cause.

9.why: In a thread whose real cause (failing eyesight) displaces an economic one, 'to correct a guess of the narrator's own' is the only option that presupposes a superseded assumption.

10.why: Scientific-caution key: confining a finding to the single pond studied, corroborated by item 26's 'unwilling to speak for others'.

11.why: Most specific and least mechanical footnote purpose; 'an objection never voted on' fits a thread whose tone item offers suspicion of the official reason.

12.why: The five 'unchanged' statements negate the five causes in item 18; if the cause is an early food bloom, the weakener is the bloom arriving no earlier.

13.why: Counterfactual set negating item 16/29's causes; the only option carrying a PROPER NAME (Marchford) is the specific one, and a rival's lowered tolls is the thread's cause.

14.why: Attitude toward the club whose records saved the study; praise is the payoff, and 'indifference' is the pure-hedge bait.

15.why: Same five causes as item 30; 'a plea from the vendors themselves' is the only option making the subject its own agent - the counterintuitive twist.

16.why: Maps to the tolls cause established by siblings 13 and 21.

17.why: 'Refusal to take sides' is the pure hedge and is bait; among the rest, suspicion of the stated reason is the nuanced key an SSAT tone item rewards.

18.why: Four options are direct physical causes; 'an early food bloom' is the only mediated biological mechanism, which is the non-obvious finding these passages establish.

19.why: Senses of 'spring'; in a pond thread the contextual sense is a source of water, and 'the season' is the everyday-frequency bait.

20.why: Senses of 'charge'; the night-market thread explicitly involves a fee (item 15A), so the contextual sense is fee.

21.why: The only option that does NOT restate one of the thread's five candidate causes - it names an evidential procedure (following the carters' diverted route), which is the odd-one-out signature of the key in this thread.

22.why: Main-idea item; sibling 25's 'someone to read her proofs aloud' is the only person-based remedy and points at failing eyesight.

23.why: Most specific of the sympathetic options and coherent with a branch swamped by another's readers; the explicit 'refusal to pass judgement' is the pure-hedge bait.

24.why: Mixed/qualified attitude ('admiration touched by regret') against three unmixed ones and one pure-detachment hedge; SSAT literary tone keys are qualified.

25.why: Four options are structural or commercial fixes; the only remedy requiring another PERSON is the odd one out, and it names the cause (eyesight) obliquely.

26.why: Scope-limited confidence is the standing scientific-caution key and matches item 10's 'confine the finding to the single pond'.

27.why: The only option naming something NOBODY CAN SUPPLY; four remedies are actionable and one is not, and that asymmetry is the marked option.

28.why: Sibling 27's unavailable remedy is cooler summers, so the cause the thread establishes is warmer water.

29.why: Main-idea item for the market thread; 13 and 21 both point at a rival town's tolls diverting the carters.

30.why: Only option in which the night market's own vendors are the agents of its end - the counterintuitive resolution, corroborated by item 15C.
